Notes: Live text from Randy's ICC Shuttleport scrape 2026-10-30 (dialogs_raw 4582, 14:28-16:07 ET). Manager Travis Molen (930x890). Armor jobs per the live briefs: Pants=Climbing Salamanders, Sleeves=Shuttle Saboteur, Gloves=Stowaway Rollerrats, Body Armor=Giant Snakes, Boots=Cross-Wired Junkbots. Turn-ins complete on target (no turn-in dialog). Medics and "Factions?"/"How do I leave" answers were not captured and keep their stand-ins. Generated by ddogs/tools/Build-Live4582.py.

armor.Text: I heard you might help me get some armor?

shot_down.Text: You got that right.  Our shuttle was blown out of the sky by the aliens!

need_help.Text: It looks like you need some help here.

ask_unicorns.Text: Maybe I can help you with the Unicorns?

ask_medics.Text: Maybe I can help some of the medics here, sort of ease the suffering?

want_body.Text: I want the Newcomer's Body Armor.

Text: Yes, yes, yes?!
{delay 1}{emote}Travis Molen glances at you briefly, then turns his attention back to the raging battle.{/emote}
{emote}Travis suddenly stops and takes a good look at you. He slowly raises one of his eyebrows.{/emote}
{delay 3}You're not from around here, are you?
At least you're alive...
{delay 2}\nThat's more than I can say for the majority of those guys.
{delay 2}{emote}Travis points towards the intense battle that is taking place on the giant platform.{/emote}

soldiers.Text: Some were employed by me and some were sent here by different factions on Rubi-Ka.

Text: {emote}Travis Molen glances quickly in the direction where the Unicorn Commander is located.{/emote}
{delay 2}I sure am.
We sure do! Just look at the soldiers being sent to certain death!
{delay 3}\nThe Unicorn Commander has no respect for human life.
{delay 2}\nOmni-Tek will never change.
{givequest DTO0}Just make sure they have everything they need, and hopefully they'll find the situation here stable enough to leave.
{delay 2}\nIf you happen to come across a status report regarding their progress here, it would be much appreciated.

busy_unicorns.Text: Just make sure they have everything they need. If you happen to come across a status report regarding their progress here, it would be much appreciated.

offer_medics.Text: Clan Field Surgeon Elsa Oosta is patching up the wounded down the ramp. Get me her status report.

Text: {givequest DTC0}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.

busy_medics.Text: Talk to Elsa Oosta down the ramp.

armor.Text: Well, I do have some Newcomer's armor left, but to qualify for the armor pieces, you would have to help me out here first.

pick.Text: Good. Now, there are various tasks I need you to look into. But, it might be easier if we start the other way around, what armor part would you be interested in?

Text: {givequest DTA0}I need some help removing some of the Climbing Salamanders.

{delay 1}The environmentalists on Rubi-Ka managed to convince ICC to keep some of the wildlife here on this island when we built the Shuttleport, but we can't have them running wild up here. Better they stay on the beach where they aren't in the way I say.
{delay 2}Up here, they keep getting landed on... I don't feel bad for them if that's what you think, but it gets all over passenger's boots and then all over the floor in the teleporter tower.

{delay 2}The cleaning staff are not going to stop harassing me until I get this fixed. And if I hear about how hard it is to get salamander blood off carbonum tile floors one more time, I might have to shoot someone!
{givequest DTS0}We have had a lot more crashes than normal lately. Unfortunately they haven't all been caused by the alien attackers. I have reports of people sabotaging our shuttles...

{delay 1}please investigate this report. If you find anyone tampering with our shuttles please terminate them with the utmost prejudice. If you manage to take one of these guys out I'll give you the Newcomer's Sleeves.

give_gloves.Text: {givequest DTG0}Ok, I hope you can help us with an issue down at the secondary landing pads. We're looking for some stowaway rollerrats that we believe escaped from one of the shuttles. The rollerrats are constantly harassing the technicians making it impossible to work. They should be easy to kill... it's just that there are so MANY of them...

Text: {givequest DTP0}I have received reports that the Giant Snakes have symptoms that could be the start of some disease, and so it is important we take care of the Giant Snakes as a precaution.
{delay 1} If you go and eliminate a few of them, I'll give you the Newcomer's Body Armor.
{givequest DTB0}I need you to go and pull the plug on the Cross-Wired Junkbots down on the secondary landing pads.
{delay 1} One of our staff said he was fixing these... we are now sure he had no idea what he was doing. After the robots tried to kill our technicians twice... we had to admit there was a problem.

busy_pants.Text: I need some help removing some of the Climbing Salamanders. Three of them, out on the terraformed area to the west.

busy_sleeves.Text: If you find anyone tampering with our shuttles please terminate them with the utmost prejudice.

busy_gloves.Text: The stowaway rollerrats down at the secondary landing pads. They should be easy to kill... it's just that there are so MANY of them...

busy_body.Text: Eliminate a few of the Giant Snakes out on the terraformed area to the west, and I'll give you the Newcomer's Body Armor.

busy_boots.Text: Pull the plug on the Cross-Wired Junkbots down on the secondary landing pads.
